answer.book: A disputation (dissertatio) by Simon Battier, Basel 1655, on the law of wills, with a title page, a dedication to patrons, and a body of numbered theses (Thesis I onward) with Latin legal citations; the sheet covers scans 2 to 25 of 30, so the series may continue past XXXIV in the unseen scans 26 to 30, and the count is the highest numeral seen, not a verified total.
